nom: Weleda Skin Food Face Care Nourishing Day Cream, 1.3 Fluid Ounce, Plant Rich Moisturizer with Olive Leaf Extract, Squalane and Chamomile

avis.texte: Weleda Skin Food Face Care Nourishing Day Cream is a luxurious skincare product that has enhanced my daily beauty routine. Bursting with plant-based goodness, this cream's formulation includes a medley of olive leaf, calendula, pansy, and squalane, delivering a deeply nourishing experience that my skin has been craving. The delicate infusion of chamomile adds a soothing touch, making it a rejuvenating experience every time I apply the cream. The subtle, calming fragrance further enhances the overall sensory delight of using this product, making it an integral part of my self-care ritual. As an environmentally conscious consumer, I appreciate its vegan formulation, and its certification by NATRUE reaffirms its commitment to natural ingredients. One of the standout features of this day cream is its ability to provide long-lasting moisture without any greasy residue. Upon application, it effortlessly seeps into my skin, leaving behind a velvety finish that feels indulgent yet weightless. The quick absorption ensures that I can seamlessly apply my makeup without any unwanted smudges or clumps. I highly recommend this product to anyone who is suffering from dry skin.

avis.titre: Beautiful moisturizer, Nature’s Answer to Thirsty Skin 🌿✨
avis.texte: This day cream blends plant-rich ingredients like calendula, pansy, and olive leaf to deeply hydrate without feeling greasy. It leaves skin soft, radiant, and nourished all day while still layering well under makeup. The texture is silky, the scent is herbal, and even a small dab goes a long way. The price point is really good for such high quality moisturizer with clean ingredients. The sent is just beautiful! Tip: Warm between fingers before applying to the face, this really helps for the smoothest absorption. I highly recommend this moisturizer & I hope you find this review is helpful 👍🏻

Introduced to this brand when we were with our German friends, Weleda has become a staple in our house from handcream to face moisturizer. While their handcream can be almost excessively thick, perfect for those dry winter months, I was looking for something lighter for my face, that would provide moisture without any additional greasiness. I read a lot of good reviews about this product and decided to try it. It was absolutely perfect. The level of moisture is exactly what you’re looking for, just as much as you need and not more. It feels great on your skin, is easy to apply, and instantly rehydrates after a good cleansing. The scent is outstanding and one of my favorite features. This is a light, daily use moisturizer that will become your go to on a regular basis. Couldn’t be happier.

I've been a fan of Weleda Skin Food ever since the first time I bought a small tube and used it to treat chapped corners of my mouth. I've smeared the stuff on my face at night before because I love and trust it, even though it's really a bit thick for that business. Well, along comes this day cream! Important question straight out of the pot: does it smell like Skin Food? By golly, yes it does! It smells good. And, being conceived as a facial moisturizer for daytime use, the stuff goes on a bit easier and feels less sticky than regular Skin Food. I wasn't a big moisturizer person before, but as I've gotten older my face has been feeling dry. This is a nice moisturizer to treat that. It does make my face look a little shiny, which I'm not sure I love, but I don't think it's the biggest deal in the world. I'm happy to have my Skin Food.

I love this product but the container comes 1/2 filled. This is the second order that came this way.Container is 1/2 filled. The photos The first weighed container is empty the 2nd is brand new. It's supposed to be 1.3 oz.

I remember this in a metal tube at my health food store in the 1970s! I just rediscovered it in Paris (made in Switzerland) and I love it! I have sensitive skin and eyes and it doesn’t cause either to react. Lightweight and effectively moisturizing. The pm version feels a little sticky to me but the daytime is great for night too. I wish they had one with sunscreen, but I just put a layer of La Roche Posay 30 over it and I’m good to go!

avis.titre: Where have you been all my life?
avis.texte: Oh my gosh, I love this so much! This feels light and rich at the same time. The smell is amazing - it just smells fresh. You don't need a lot, so it lasts quite a long time.
Los productos WELEDA son super sanos y los resultados increíbles. Altamente recomendable. Sin duda los volveré a comprar.

avis.titre: Light to apply so a little goes a long way
avis.texte: Excellent product from Weleda,light and easy to apply,great on eyelids aswell as facial areas,organic and chemical free!
Weleda es una buena marca Hidrata muy bien la piel Buen servicio

Let me see where I begin. Well, the texture isn't super light, but it's not heavy either; it's somewhere in between. I feel like it's more for dry or normal skin. Even though I have oily skin, it doesn't clog my pores. I bought it because there are days when my skin is out of control and gets really dry. It has a nice scent. Just don't put it too close to your eyes. If you have sensitive skin, it might irritate you a little. In conclusion, it is quite moisturizing and it's best used at night.

My friends in Europe recommended this moisturizer and I finally ordered it. It came in a box AND FULLY sealed (I had to peel the foil) which is very important. Light texture but feels nourishing, absorbs in seconds and has a nice light scent. My skin is soft but not sticky. I have sensitive skin/rosacea and no issues. It doesn’t have SPF and it’s fine because I use it at night too since most night creams are too greasy for me. I’m very happy with this product!

First time using this face product and I'm so happy to report I have not had any breakouts. It smells lovely and the consistency is just right. A little goes a long way. I'm so glad I got it. Heads up, the warning on the box about the tight seal is very true! I recommend it!

I really like the light feel of this cream product . It’s something I needed for travel. Good size for travel 1.3 oz. A bit pricey but worth it. It dose keep your face moisturized for a good amount of hours. Has a light scent.
A very good cream. The texture is delicate and nourishes dry skin well.

avis.titre: Hydrates and gives a healthy glow
avis.texte: I have been using the Welda Nourishing Day Cream, along with the Welda Nourishing Night Cream, for a week and a half now. A little goes a long way, and it absorbs well. It hydrates and smooths my skin and gives it a glow. I recently tried an extremely expensive serum with sunflower sprout extract, so I was interested to see that this moisturizer has sunflower oil as its second ingredient. I'm not sure exactly what the difference is, but my guess is that sunflower oil isn't quite as potent. It still has a lot of skin benefits and is naturally rich in Vitamin E. This product contains a lot of other great hydrating, smoothing and firming ingredients like glycerin, shea butter, squalane, olive leaf extract and centella asiatica a.k.a. cica (see photo). However, one thing I was surprised to see is alcohol. I found some information on the Welda website that made me feel better about this. It says, "Weleda uses a 'raw grain alcohol,' a naturally-fermented plant-based sugar that helps preserve our ingredients and helps our products stay gluten-free. This alcohol is not drying, in fact, it is used to hold and stabilize our botanical tinctures and extracts... Our alcohol is denatured by the essential oils in the formulas. Additionally, our products are gently heated which further diminishes any drying aspect of alcohol in the emulsified product." Still this might not be the best for all skin types. Along the same lines, fragrance is added but it is said to be from natural essential oil
I think I’ll still use it but I got sent a jar that expired in August 2024 when I ordered in May 2025…

I have purchased this product several times. The last two jars have had finished amounts in them; this time it’s too much. The weleda customer support is non existent… voicemail says to expect an extended delay to get a response. There are other products to use.

This face cream smells light and fresh and doesn't leave an oily residue on the skin. It's a bit light for my dry skin so I apply a face oil underneath it. Would probably be perfect for oily/combination skin.

This is tightly sealed, you have to really pry off the foil. I love the scent, it reminds me of orange peels. It’s incredibly rich, so much that I’m not able to regularly use it on my slightly oily face. However it’s perfect for my neck and hands…it sinks in and leaves my hands soft. This is a wonderful brand and I much prefer the natural scents to the artificial cheaper brands, definitely a must for dry skin.

This is a great moisturizer, it’s creamy, spreads easily, it absorbs fast and leaves my skin snotty and hydrated. There’s no greasy or tacky feel left behind and it didn’t cause irritation to my face or neck. The scent is subtle and fresh. I’ll update my review if I experience any issues but so far so good. I like it.
Works great and doesn’t leave any oil or grease. Smells excellent!
